name: aygun-tarhan-marder-spacetime-2006
description: Aygun, Aygun & Tarhan's 'Energy Momentum Localization in Marder Space Time' (arXiv gr-qc/0607102, 2006) was removed by arXiv administrators, who stated directly: 'This paper has been removed by arXiv administrators because it plagiarizes hep-th/0308070, gr-qc/9910015, and others.' Both cited sources are S.S. Xulu's work (University of Zululand) -- his PhD thesis and a short paper -- with no author overlap with Aygun/Aygun/Tarhan, so this is genuine cross-author plagiarism. See manual_examples/aygun-tarhan-marder-spacetime-2006/case.json.

papers.title: Energy Momentum Localization in Marder Space Time

manual.reason: arXiv removed the paper (v3, 2007) for plagiarism -- the withdrawn version itself now 404s, so v1 (pre-withdrawal, still carries the plagiarized text) is fetched by hand rather than relying on retrieve_papers.py's normal DOI-resolution path, which would try to reach the withdrawn/current version. Fetched fresh over the network each run (no local_path -- a third party's copyrighted work this project doesn't hold redistribution rights to, so it isn't committed to the repo).
